The machine is ideal for municipal corporations, recycling plants, waste transfer stations, RDF production facilities, and integrated waste management projects. Its modular design allows customization based on required processing capacity.

The Plastic Waste Grinder Machine is built for modern plastic recycling facilities requiring efficient size reduction of plastic waste. Equipped with hardened steel rotary blades, the grinder processes bottles, containers, injection molding scrap, pipes, sheets, and other plastic products into uniform flakes for further recycling.

The machine features a heavy-duty mild steel frame, low-vibration operation, and energy-efficient motor, making it suitable for continuous industrial use. Multiple capacities are available to meet the requirements of small, medium, and large recycling plants.

Powered by a heavy-duty electric motor and fitted with hardened steel cutting blades, the machine provides uniform shredding while maintaining low energy consumption. The rugged mild steel body and industrial-grade components ensure long operational life with minimal maintenance.

shortDescription: The Organic & Coconut Waste Shredder is a robust industrial shredding machine designed for reducing coconut waste, garden waste, agricultural residue, and organic biomass into smaller particles for composting, recycling, or biomass processing.

name: Integrated Smart Pole

The Integrated Smart Pole is a next-generation intelligent urban infrastructure platform engineered to support modern Smart City initiatives. By integrating multiple technologies into a single pole, it eliminates the need for separate installations while improving operational efficiency, aesthetics, and public services.

Powered by a high-efficiency monocrystalline solar panel, the system generates renewable energy to operate its integrated components while reducing dependency on conventional power. An AI-powered PTZ surveillance camera delivers 360° monitoring with intelligent analytics such as object detection, facial recognition, intrusion alerts, and night vision.

The Smart Pole continuously monitors environmental conditions through integrated air quality and weather sensors capable of measuring AQI, CO₂, PM2.5, PM10, temperature, humidity, and ambient noise levels. A built-in 4G/LTE + Wi-Fi hotspot provides high-speed wireless internet connectivity for citizens and IoT devices.

For public communication, the system incorporates a Full HD outdoor LED display for advertisements, emergency alerts, and public information, along with a public address system for live or scheduled announcements. An integrated SOS emergency button enables instant communication with emergency response teams, while the optional EV charging unit supports electric vehicle charging infrastructure.

Its modular architecture allows customization based on project requirements, making it suitable for smart transportation, public safety, digital advertising, environmental monitoring, and sustainable urban development projects.
shortDescription: The Integrated Smart Pole is an advanced multi-functional urban infrastructure solution that combines intelligent surveillance, renewable solar power, environmental monitoring, public communication, digital advertising, EV charging, emergency response, and smart connectivity into a single modular system.
